violation_type.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches (26 TAC §744.3255(a))
violation_type.short_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches
violation_type.typical_finding: The children playground loose fill is less than an inch ruler.

finding_variants.text: The children playground loose fill is less than an inch ruler.
It was found during the inspection the operation did not have enough loose fill  on the playground  for the equipment on the playground.
The operation did not maintain loose-fill surfacing materials they do not have a least nine inches for the play area that is greater than five feet or less.

The use zones for the climbing structure and the swings do not have an acceptable depth of uncompressed loose fill surfacing. There is a lot of grass growing up through the surfacing that has compacted a lot of it.
The loose fill on the playground did not meet the 9 inches of required depth in front of and around the slides.
